answer_text: Yes—Cato supports IPv6-only last-mile connections from branch sites to the Cato Cloud. The Cato Client can use IPv6-only last-mile networks and relies on NAT64 to translate IPv6 addresses to IPv4 addresses. It also supports last-mile connections in dual-stack environments where IPv4 is disabled. Roadmap details for next year, including specific dates, are not available in the knowledge base.
